prompt: Bug report from a user: "`trailhead plan route.csv --fitness 1.5` prints exactly the same days as `trailhead plan route.csv`. `trailhead summary` does take `--fitness` into account." Find the cause and fix it.

grep -n "plan" tests/test_cli.py | head; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -15

python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3 && git stash -q && python -m pytest -q tests/test_plan.py 2>&1 | tail -2; git stash pop -q && PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead plan tests/conftest.py --fitness 1.5 2>&1 | head -3; git status --short
